channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Final Club Night of the 2024/2025 Season!
item.description: Join us for the final Club Night of the season for an evening of fun before wrapping up.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Navan Badminton Club Night: Join Us!
item.description: Join us for a fun badminton night at Claremont Stadium with open courts, starting with the Juvenile Club at 6:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 🐰 Happy Easter!
item.description: Wishing everyone a great Easter Sunday filled with fun, smiles, and sweet treats.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♀️ Thursday Club Night: Badminton Superheroes!
item.description: Join us this Thursday at Claremont Stadium for an exciting badminton night with a Power Ranger twist. Get ready for intense matches and lots of fun!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night: Join the Fun!
item.description: Join us for Wednesday Club Night with exciting badminton matches and open courts for practice. Fun for all ages and skill levels.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night Fun!
item.description: Join us for a night of fun and practice with open courts and no scores. Kids' Club Night starts at 6:30pm!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night: Badminton Fun
item.description: Join us for a night of intense badminton action at Wednesday Club Night. Open courts, exciting matches, and fun for all!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Badminton Night at Claremont
item.description: Join us for a fun badminton night at Claremont from 9pm to 11pm, open to beginners, social members, and regulars.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us tonight from 8pm to 11pm at Claremont Stadium for Wednesday Club Night. Whether you're great at badminton or just starting, we’ve got a court for you. Everyone’s welcome!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Roll Up, Shuttlecock Smashers! Week 3 of Summer Club
item.description: Join us for Week 3 of our Summer Club tonight from 8 PM to 11 PM at Claremont Stadium for a night full of fun, laughter, and badminton for just €8!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
